## Critique
- claim-1: Correctly grounded. Source-30 presents the numerical equality only as a consequence of Conjecture 4.10, not as a theorem [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 938-955].
- claim-2: The supplied argument proves this preservation statement. The integral Schubert basis [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 61-66] and dissector decomposition [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 643-648, 664-683] give \(u\ge v_m\iff u\not\le w_m\). Thus the two integral spans are literally the same homogeneous ideal in \(A_m\), so their homogeneous generating sets—and hence their \(\mu_{A_m}\)-values—coincide. This does not transfer minimality from the Grassmannian subring.
- claim-3: Correctly identifies the decisive gap. No supplied internal theorem with a durable locator establishes the numerical equality in \(A_m\); the internal audit records this absence at `artifacts/internal-sources/ba093e9698dcd534de3dc53890f1b8d8396115df56ecc3710605037120fde810/artifact.txt@L1-L62`.

## Repair certificates
- [source-refresh] Supply a verbatim accepted internal theorem and immutable locator asserting, for every \(m\ge1\), with \(A_m=H^\star(GL_{4m}/B,\mathbb Z)\) and \(v_m=v_{2m,2m,m+1,4m}\),
  \[
  \mu_{A_m}\!\left(\mathbb Z\text{-span}\{\sigma_u:u\ge v_m\}\right)=\binom{2m}{m},
  \]
  where \(\mu_{A_m}\) counts homogeneous \(A_m\)-generators. A theorem only about inclusion-minimality in \(\Lambda/I_{2m,2m}\) is insufficient.

## Required revisions
- Insert the missing numerical theorem, all hypotheses, and its durable locator.
- Retain the integral Schubert-basis proof that \(J_{v_m}^{A_m}=I_{w_m}^{A_m}\).
- Until the missing theorem is supplied, conclude that generator-number preservation is proved but the requested numerical certificate is not established.
